name: Petr Yan

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (67 in height, 67 in reach, born 1993-02-11); fight weight = bantamweight limit 135 lb

photo_coverage: Good. Studio headshot and two full-body cut-outs (Dec 2025 and probably Oct 2026), two freely licensed Kremlin photos from 22 Apr 2026 (near-frontal and near-profile of his left side, CC BY 4.0), Oct 2026 UFC 333 press-conference and weigh-in face-off photos (near-profile of his right side), a UFC 323 media-day front view and a full-body UFC 323 fight photo. The 2018 Commons still is old (stubble only) and used only for bone structure.

face.shape: Broad square-to-rectangular face, wide at both the cheekbones and the jaw, solid and full rather than gaunt. In front view it looks fairly short and wide, helped by the beard and a thick neck.
face.jaw: Wide and strong with squared angles; the beard outline makes the lower face look square.
face.chin: Broad and rounded with moderate projection; the beard adds about 1.5-2.5 cm below the chin and looks rounded-pointed in profile (Apr 2026).
face.cheekbones: Broad and moderately high; cheeks full and firm, bunching into round apples when he smiles (UFC 333 presser).
face.brow_ridge: Moderately strong; brows sit low and heavy over hooded eyes, giving a steady, slightly squinting look at rest.
face.forehead: Broad, medium height, made to look higher by deep temple recession; faint horizontal lines.

eyes.shape: Almond, fairly narrow, with hooded upper lids; slightly deep-set; small under-eye bags.
eyes.colour: Light hazel / grey-green: greenish-grey iris with an amber-brown ring around the pupil and a darker outer ring (ESPN headshot zoom); looks darker in the Kremlin photos. Closest MakeHuman iris: green or brownlight (not blue).

eyebrows.shape: Low and fairly straight, sloping down slightly at the outer ends.
eyebrows.colour: Medium brown, a shade lighter and warmer than the head hair (#5a3f30 approx.)

nose.width: Broad, especially at the tip and nostrils; the bridge is wide too
nose.bridge: Wide and slightly flattened; straight in profile with a slight dip at the root
nose.fight_damage: Flattened, widened bridge consistent with repeated impacts; no clear sideways deviation in the frontal photos.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-wide mouth; thin upper lip partly under the moustache, medium lower lip. Resting expression is a slight closed-mouth smirk; smile pulls the corners up and out.

ears.size: Medium-large and strongly protruding: they stand out from the head in every frontal photo (ESPN headshot, Kremlin, UFC 323 media day).
ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, both ears: thickened, lumpy upper ear and filled-in folds (right ear in the UFC 333 face-off, left ear in the Kremlin near-profile, both visible in the ESPN headshot). Already visible in 2018.

face.marks_scars: No large scars visible. Small marks near the brows may be old cuts but are not clear at this resolution.

hair.style: Short taper/fade: back and sides clipped very short (near skin at the bottom), top about 3-4 cm, textured and pushed forward and up. Same cut from Dec 2025 to Oct 2026; often under a backwards black cap at fight week.
hair.colour_note: Medium-dark brown, slightly ashy; looked lighter brown in 2018. Clearly darker and less red than the beard.
hair.hairline: Deep temple recession (M shape) with a forward central section; clearest in the Apr 2026 Kremlin front photo.

facial_hair.colour_note: Ginger / copper-brown, noticeably redder and lighter than the head hair; moustache a little darker at the centre.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin and moustache, medium on the jaw and cheeks, a little patchy high on the cheeks; natural, low cheek line.
facial_hair.shape: Short full beard about 1-2 cm, tidy, slightly longer and rounded-pointed at the chin; moustache connects; neckline under the jaw. In 2018 only stubble.

skin.tone_hex_method: Plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit cheek patches and the soft-light Kremlin forehead; flash-specular foreheads and the orange stage-light photo excluded); each sample is the mean of the 15th-85th luma-percentile pixels of the patch.
skin.tone_note: Light skin with a ruddy flush on the cheeks and nose.
skin.freckles_marks: Light-brown chest hair over the sternum and pectorals and a little on the abdomen; no notable marks visible.

body.build: Compact, lean and athletic bantamweight frame (170 cm): balanced and wiry-strong rather than bulky.
body.body_fat_note: Six-pack and obliques clearly visible in the studio cut-out (UFC 323 shorts) and the UFC 323 fight photo.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad, round deltoids, visible trapezius.
body.chest: Flat, medium pectorals with a clear lower edge; light-brown chest hair.
body.arms: Lean-muscular with visible veins; strong forearms; average length (reach equals height).
body.legs_calves: Strong, lean thighs and average calves; legs proportionate.
body.posture: Upright with the head carried slightly forward, shoulders relaxed, hands loose at the sides.
body.notable: Thick neck, protruding cauliflower ears, broad flattened nose and a ginger beard under brown hair are the strongest likeness cues.

tattoos.description: None visible on torso, arms or legs in the studio cut-outs, fight photo or weigh-in face-off.

kit.fight_shorts_recent: Black Venum shorts with a grey scalloped/scale pattern, white-black check waistband and red YAN lettering on the left leg (UFC 323, Dec 2025; ESPN stance-right).
kit.fight_shorts_champion: Black shorts with a Russian tricolour (white-blue-red) panel on the left leg, a Slavic ornament pattern, an Orthodox-cross and NO MERCY motif (ESPN stance-left, title belt).
kit.gloves: Black UFC gloves; gold as champion.
kit.weigh_in_media: Backwards black UFC cap, wooden bead necklace, light-blue wristband (UFC 333 face-off); black Venum track top with red stripes (UFC 333 presser).

morphs_height_note: macro/heightDownM 0.19 from the research/assets.md male fit heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 with H = 1.702 m; if the avatar code scales to the tale of the tape directly, this value can be dropped.

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets are not in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json. His protruding cauliflower ears are a key cue; if ear targets are added use about ears/l-ear-scale-incr and ears/r-ear-scale-incr 0.2, ears/l-ear-rot-forward and ears/r-ear-rot-forward 0.3 (stand-out), ears/l-ear-lobe-decr and ears/r-ear-lobe-decr 0.1. A thickened-helix normal map would sell the cauliflower better than shape.

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-young_caucasian_male tinted toward #d5987d, with a little extra red on cheeks and nose
render_hints.hair: short04 or short02 cut to a fade on the back and sides, tinted #3a2a22
render_hints.beard: short full-beard texture/shell #97614a (ginger), redder than the hair

notes: Confidence: high for ears, beard colour, hair, nose width and build (clear studio photos, two freely licensed Apr 2026 photos and Oct 2026 photos). Medium-high for exact face proportions. Eye colour is light hazel/grey-green (amber ring around the pupil) in the studio headshot and looks darker in the Kremlin photos. Watch for: (1) ears stick out and are cauliflowered on both sides; (2) ginger beard under medium-brown hair with deep temple recession; (3) broad, flattened nose with a rounded tip; (4) broad, full, square face on a thick neck; (5) 170 cm lean bantamweight: do not make him tall or bulky.
